title: Embodied First Exam
summary: Coding agents have passed many exams in the digital world. What is their first exam before entering the physical world? What the exam is, how nine coding agents do on its core set in three settings, and four findings on where they fail.

title: Claude Fable 5.2
summary: Claude Fable 5.2 leads every setting of the exam, most of all the Standard Setting. Its results, where and why it fails, how it solves tasks, and six of its runs in full.
